SHORT_DESCRIPTION: 75 MW SOLAR PHOTOVOLTAIC (PV) POWER PLANT IN FREE STATE PROVINCE, THROUGH CASTALIA LLC
PROJECT_TITLE: 75 MW Solar Photovoltaic (PV) Power Plant in Free State Province, through Castalia LLC
LONG_DESCRIPTION: A USTDA grant in support of Pele Green Energy (Pty) Ltd (Grantee) to fund a feasibility study (Study) to assess the technical, financial and economic viability of a 75 megawatt solar photovoltaic power plant near the town of Luckhoff in the Free State province of South Africa (Project). The U.S. firm Castalia LLC will perform the Study. The Study will provide the Grantee with the necessary technical, financial, and commercial analyses required for preparing a competitive proposal in response to Round 5 of South Africa's Renewable Energy Independent Power Producer Procurement Programme. The Study will also assess options for the Project to sell its output directly to interested municipalities, private sector industries or a bulk energy trader.

SHORT_DESCRIPTION: FEASIBILITY STUDY - 450 MW OF GAS-FIRED GENERATION AT KELVIN POWER STATION, THROUGH EHS SUPPORT LLC
PROJECT_TITLE: Feasibility Study - 450 MW of Gas-Fired Generation at Kelvin Power Station, through EHS Support LLC
LONG_DESCRIPTION: A USTDA grant is partially funding a feasibility study to assess the viability of a combined-cycle gas power plant of up to 450 megawatts and associated natural gas infrastructure at the existing Kelvin Power Station near Johannesburg in Gauteng Province, South Africa. The Project is expected to serve as an anchor for gas demand in Gauteng Province, therefore, successful implementation may lead to the upgrading of at least four other coal-fired power plants in Gauteng Province to convert to gas. The Grantee is NOVO Energy (Pty) Ltd (Grantee) and the U.S. firm EHS Support. LLC of Pittsburgh, PA will be undertaking the feasibility study.

SHORT_DESCRIPTION: COALBED METHANE DEVELOPMENT IN WATERBERG COALFIELD, THROUGH ADVANCED RESOURCES INTERNATIONAL, INC.
PROJECT_TITLE: Coalbed Methane Development in Waterberg Coalfield, through Advanced Resources International, Inc.
LONG_DESCRIPTION: A USTDA grant to Anglo Operations (Pty) Ltd funds a feasibility study to develop and commercialize a coalbed methane ('CBM') site in South Africa. The U.S. firm, Advanced Resources International, Inc., is completing the study on a sole-source basis.

SHORT_DESCRIPTION: GESP: RENEWABLE ENERGY GRID INTEGRATION PROGRAM
PROJECT_TITLE: GESP: Renewable Energy Grid Integration Program
LONG_DESCRIPTION: CTF will invest USD 30 million through the program to help kick-start and accelerate transformative investments and private finance in energy storage and renewable energy (RE). Its objective is to catalyze impact on the energy storage market and ecosystem in South Africa, as well as increase the use of RE and improve grid reliability, stability and power quality, while reducing carbon emissions. Overall, the program seeks to level the field between RE and thermal energy, not only in terms of cost, but also quality of power. By utilizing innovative de-risking structures that use blended concessional finance, the program aims to support pilot and potentially game-changing investments in the South African energy storage market, which currently faces significant barriers and high firstmover costs.
